name: the Lamplit Age
summary: Wren the First Scribe learns that the world listens; glyphcraft spreads; the Concord of Hearths joins the cultures with lamp-lit Long Roads.

name: the Quarrel
summary: The Imperative under Corvane the Loud tries to command the Listening with the Iron Sentence; the Concord resists; the war ends at the Silent Field.

name: the Hush
summary: The Listening turns away; glyphs answer weakly and relics sleep; people gather in safe valleys and keep small crafts, songs and festivals alive.

name: the Rekindling
summary: Maudry Tull relights the Old Hearth; the Lanternfold grows around it; hearthstones are relit and wayfarers set out to rediscover the Wide.
